outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram illustrating exposure time vs illumination overhead percentages, not a data plot requiring individual points.
Panel B is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves over frame number) with shaded s.e.m. bands; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a scatter/XY plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with individual condition means and error bars plus a fitted curve; scatter plots are exempt as the points themselves are the data.
Panel D consists of line plots showing individual migration tracks for each cell; these are line plots (exempt) and already represent per-cell trajectories rather than averages.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed, and individual data points (dots for each cell) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel F shows fluorescence micrographs (Mitotracker, Paxillin, Merge), not a quantitative averaged plot.
Panel G is a micrograph time-series montage, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a micrograph time-series montage, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel I is a line plot (normalized cell area over time, mean±s.e.m., n=5); line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Panel J is a line plot (normalized mitochondrial area over time, mean±s.e.m., n=5); line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
